test_bert_score: test the bert_score embedding-based scorer module for machine translation evaluation
test_laser: test the laser embedding-based scorer module for machine translation evaluation
run_test_suite: run a unittest test suite loaded from test_bert_score and test_laser modules with verbosity 3
load_tests_from_module: load test cases from test_bert_score and test_laser modules into a unittest test suite
create_test_runner: create a unittest TextTestRunner with verbosity 3 to execute the embedding-based scorer test suite
